name: Bold Ideas 2 My Desktop
detailed_description:
• The URL for the detailed tutorial and update log is embedded in "Bold Ideas 2 My Desktop." Click OK on the startup screen to open the URL. There's also a button in the game settings to open the URL and turn off the startup screen.

  • First of all, thank you all for your suggestions and feedback. However, as a single developer, I couldn't even address 5% of the suggestions in such a short time. So, I had to prioritize the important parts and tackle them one by one! Finally, in three weeks, I completed the workshop, added over 20 features, and added over 20 maps.

  • Of course, I knew it wasn't enough. By the time of release, I'd barely finished the features, with many details still to be optimized. The UI was simply cobbled together for functionality, and I didn't leave enough time for testing and bug fixing.

  • Thank you again for your support and tolerance. Three days after release, I urgently fixed and improved over 30 bugs and improvements. It's now usable, and I will continue to update and maintain it!

  • "Bold Ideas 2 My Desktop" is a desktop beautification and file management software. Drag various desktop files into your favorite 3D map and generate corresponding 3D icons. You can watch the 3D icons wander around the map or even just sleep. When needed, double-click the 3D icon to open the corresponding file.

  • The core purpose is to bring fun to boring work. Many people have a cluttered mess of computer files. My Desktop embeds itself into the computer desktop, transforming it into a small, interactive space. Files and folders placed on the desktop become eye-catching 3D icons, enhancing your desktop.
